checks.note: The file confirms the mechanics: processCashOut has no @Transactional, the two writeLedgerEntry debits commit before paymentGateway.refund, and the catch-block compensation only covers a thrown PaymentGatewayException, not a crash. But the finding's claim that nothing re-drives orphaned debits requires the mandated repo-wide check (grep for CASH_OUT in outbox handlers, scheduled jobs, RefundReconciliationService), and that code is not available here.

StripePaymentGateway.chargeAndCapture does load StripeCustomer (line 83), call Stripe, then save() the whole entity (line 121) with no re-read, so the lost-update mechanism is plausible — but the outcome hinges on StripeCustomer.java (presence/absence of @Version or @DynamicUpdate) and SessionPackPaymentResource's concurrent card-save path, neither of which is provided here.

purchasePack/createPurchase indeed insert unconditionally with no lookup by stripePaymentIntentId, matching the finding at the service layer. But the verification caveat cannot be run: V138__baseline_schema.sql (unique index on stripe_payment_intent_id), the PaymentGateway.chargeAndCapture idempotency-bucket implementation, and the purchase controller are not available in this session (file search tools disabled, only this file provided), so the double-pack consequence cannot be confirmed or refuted.

In-file the mechanics hold: purchasePack is non-transactional, chargeAndCapture completes before createPurchase persists, and the refund/reconciliation path exists only in the in-process catch block, so a crash in between leaves no DB trace. But the finding's own caveat — whether a webhook handler reconciles session_pack_purchases from payment_intent.succeeded — cannot be checked: search tools are disabled and only this file was provided.

The unguarded check-then-insert race in getOrCreateStripeCustomer is real (findById/orElseGet/save with no transaction or lock around the Stripe call), but whether the loser's save merge-updates (overwrite) or persist-fails on the parent_id primary key depends on the StripeCustomer entity mapping (@Version field or Persistable.isNew override), which is not shown here — exactly the finding's own verification caveat.
